entries.title: Exodus 26:1
segments: And you shall make the tabernacle [with] ten curtains of fine twined bleached [linen], and blue, and purple, and scarlet. You shall make them with cherubs, of the work of a cunning workman.

entries.title: Exodus 26:2
segments: The length of one curtain [shall be] twenty-eight cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits. And every one of the curtains shall have one measure.

entries.title: Exodus 26:3
segments: The five curtains shall be coupled together, each to its sister. And five curtains shall be coupled together, each to its sister.

entries.title: Exodus 26:4
segments: And you shall make loops of blue on the edge of one curtain, from the end at the juncture; and so you shall do at the edge of the last curtain, at the second juncture.

entries.title: Exodus 26:5
segments: You shall make fifty loops in the one curtain, and you shall make fifty loops in the end of the curtain which [is] at second juncture, the corresponding loops each to her sister.

entries.title: Exodus 26:6
segments: You shall make fifty clasps of gold, and you shall join the curtains each to her sister by the clasps. And it shall be one tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 26:7
segments: And you shall make curtains [of] goats' [hair] to be a tent over the tabernacle. You shall make eleven curtains.

entries.title: Exodus 26:8
segments: The length of one curtain [shall be] thirty cubits, and the breadth of one curtain four cubits, one measure to the eleven curtains.

entries.title: Exodus 26:9
segments: And you shall join five curtains by themselves, and six curtains by themselves. And you shall double the sixth curtain in the forefront of the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 26:10
segments: And you shall make fifty loops on the edge of one curtain, the last at the juncture, and fifty loops in the edge of the curtain that joins second.

entries.title: Exodus 26:11
segments: And you shall make fifty clasps of bronze, and put the clasps into the loops, and couple the tent together, so that it may be one.

entries.title: Exodus 26:12
segments: And the rest that remains of the curtains of the tent, the half curtain that remains, shall hang over the backside of the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 26:13
segments: And the cubit from this side, and the cubit from that side that remains in the length of the curtains of the tent shall be hung over the sides of the tabernacle, from this and from that side, to cover it.

entries.title: Exodus 26:14
segments: And you shall make a covering for the tent [of] rams' skins dyed red, and a covering above of dugong skins.

entries.title: Exodus 26:15
segments: And you shall make boards for the tabernacle [of] acacia-wood standing up.

entries.title: Exodus 26:16
segments: Ten cubits [shall be] the length of one board, and a cubit and a half shall be the breadth of one board.

entries.title: Exodus 26:17
segments: There [shall be] two pins in one board, each connected to its sister-piece. So you shall do for all the boards of the tabernacle.

entries.title: Exodus 26:18
segments: And you shall make the boards for the tabernacle, twenty boards on the south side southward.

entries.title: Exodus 26:19
segments: And you shall make forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards-- two sockets under one board for its two pins, and two sockets under another board for its two pins.

entries.title: Exodus 26:20
segments: And for the second side of the tabernacle on the north side [shall be] twenty boards,

entries.title: Exodus 26:21
segments: and their forty sockets [of] silver, two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

entries.title: Exodus 26:22
segments: And for the sides of the tabernacle westward you shall make six boards.

entries.title: Exodus 26:23
segments: And you shall make two boards for the corners of the tabernacle in the sides.

entries.title: Exodus 26:24
segments: And they shall be coupled together beneath, and they shall be coupled together above the head of it to one ring. So it shall be for them both. They shall be for the two corners.

entries.title: Exodus 26:25
segments: And [there] shall be eight boards, and their sockets [of] silver, sixteen sockets, two sockets under one board, and two sockets under another board.

entries.title: Exodus 26:26
segments: And you shall make bars [of] acacia-wood, five for the boards of the one side of the tabernacle,

entries.title: Exodus 26:27
segments: and five bars for the boards of the other side of the tabernacle; and five bars for the side of the tabernacle, for the two sides westward.

entries.title: Exodus 26:28
segments: And the middle bar in the midst of the boards shall reach from end to end.

entries.title: Exodus 26:29
segments: And you shall overlay the boards [with] gold, and you shall make their rings [of] gold, housings for the bars. And you shall overlay the bars with gold.

entries.title: Exodus 26:30
segments: And you shall rear up the tabernacle according to the pattern of it which was shown you in the mountain.

entries.title: Exodus 26:31
segments: And you shall make a veil [of] blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen] of embroidered work. It shall be made [with] cherubs.

entries.title: Exodus 26:32
segments: And you shall hang it upon four pillars of acacia overlaid [with] gold. Their hooks [shall be] of gold, upon the four sockets of silver.

entries.title: Exodus 26:33
segments: And you shall hang up the veil under the clasps, that you may bring the ark of the testimony in there within the veil. And the veil shall divide for you between the holy [place] and the Holy of Holies.

entries.title: Exodus 26:34
segments: And you shall put the mercy-seat upon the ark of the testimony in the Holy of Holies.

entries.title: Exodus 26:35
segments: And you shall set the table outside the veil, and the lampstand over against the table on the side of the tabernacle toward the south. And you shall put the table on the north side.

entries.title: Exodus 26:36
segments: And you shall make a screen for the door of the tent, [of] blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined bleached [linen], worked with needlework.

entries.title: Exodus 26:37
segments: And you shall make five pillars of acacia-wood for the screen, and overlay them [with] gold; their hooks [shall be] of gold. And you shall cast five sockets of bronze for them.
